name: v0.3.11 preregistered multi-target replication
one_shot_semantics: Run the preregistered 27-cell matrix once after protocol commit (P0) and target-suite freeze commit (P1). Rerun only exact cells that fail for infrastructure reasons. Do not change budgets, policies, seeds, generator, or apps after seeing outcomes.
research_question: Does the exact same frozen v0.3.9 return-cycle guard replicate across multiple preregistered fresh application shapes, while preserving successful-return safety and C1 findings?
success_means: Protocol integrity and reproducible evidence, not necessarily Outcome A.

candidate.cycle_rule: During an unresolved return phase, arriving at an exact destination signature already seen in that phase (parent not matched) is a return cycle. First exact repeat triggers escape. No N, no cluster-only trigger, no app hardcode.
candidate.escape_semantics: Abandon active branch: returning=false, active_branch empty, parent cleared, commitment_left=0. Do not _complete_branch. Do not increment return_success / completed_total. Do not add to returned/completed. Event return_cycle_escape; optional sequence_terminal outcome return_cycle_abandoned if instance still open (L1). If the instance already terminally ended, escape is L2 cleanup with no second sequence_terminal.

seed_derivation.rule: seed(app_name) = first 8 hex digits of SHA256("ghostqa-v0.3.11:" + app_name) interpreted as unsigned integer

targets.name: buggy-wiki
emphasis: several exact variants in same semantic cluster

targets.name: buggy-ops
emphasis: successful return requiring more than one intermediate state

matrix.seed_rationale: All matrix policies are deterministic (GhostPolicy without LLM, BFS, DFS). No RandomPolicy/Monkey. Single seed is seed-invariant. App generation seeds are separate and frozen in this protocol.

c1_cycle_detector.rule: An evaluable return-cycle opportunity exists when an unresolved return phase revisits the same exact destination signature before matching the recorded parent.
c1_cycle_detector.consistency: For every guard escape, the detector run on that guard evidence must yield a corresponding opportunity. Count equality alone is not enough. Duplicate steps compare as a multiset of structured keys.

classes.L1: open-instance abandonment: instance still open; sequence_terminal outcome=return_cycle_abandoned; no returned terminal for that instance; no return_success inflation; return obligation cleared
classes.L2: already-terminal-return cleanup: instance already terminally ended (e.g. finding) with return obligation still active; escape allowed; no second sequence_terminal; no returned/completed inflation; prior terminal remains authoritative

escape_lifecycle.v0310_regression: 7 escapes and 6 return_cycle_abandoned terminals are explained as 6 L1 + 1 L2

S3.name: same cluster, distinct exact variants
S3.expected: zero escape solely because cluster repeats/similarity occurs

S4.name: exact self-loop
S4.expected: exactly one escape, abandoned, not returned

S5.name: short A→B→A cycle
S5.expected: escape on first exact repeated destination, branch abandoned, no return success

S6.name: history reset between branches
S6.expected: cycle history from branch one must not poison branch two

S7.name: finding then cycle
S7.expected: finding followed by cycle escape must not convert into successful return

exhaustive_model_check.kind: deterministic bounded enumeration, not a theorem prover

contamination.fresh_target_results: must not be used to change candidate behavior in this round

A.label: multi-target replication with safety
all: exhaustive bounded safety checker has zero failures
every guard escape on every fresh target maps to a detector opportunity
lifecycle accounting has zero unclassified escapes
guard loses zero C1 confirmed bugs on all three targets @120
guard loses zero C1 successful-return branch keys where comparison is meaningful
at least 2 of 3 fresh targets contain an evaluable C1 or guard return-cycle opportunity
at least 2 of 3 targets show a valid guard escape followed by measurable post-escape novelty absent from that target's C1
A.interpretation: preregistered multi-target replication of the return-cycle mechanism

B.label: safe but mixed replication
B.when: Safety/integrity all pass and no C1 bug/return regressions occur, but only one target demonstrates transfer benefit, OR replication evidence is mixed/equivalent.

C.label: harmful/regression
any: detector/escape inconsistency that indicates mechanism-accounting failure
any C1 confirmed bug lost on any target @120
historical freeze/regression failure caused by this round

D.label: inconclusive suite
D.when: Fewer than 2 of 3 targets present evaluable return-cycle opportunities under preregistered budgets, safety passes, no C1 regression.
D.stop: Do not raise budget after D.

evidence_supports_productization_study_r: at least 2 v0.3.11 fresh targets replicate
no C1 losses across fresh targets

authoring_bias_disclosure_required: These targets are preregistered fresh targets, not independently designed external benchmarks.
The v0.3.9 candidate was frozen before this round.
Target identities, seeds, topology families, budgets, and bug-count ranges are preregistered before any policy evaluation.
Generator must not accept or reject topology based on policy score.
This is not universal generalization proof.
